messages:
maria_dev: Heads-up: PR #4321 updates the API ref for POST /classify attachments field. Current example shows attachments as an object ("attachments": { ... }) but runtime prefers an array of objects. Can we align the examples? cc @tim_docs @sanjay_infra

tim_docs: I saw that — curl and python snippets show different shapes too. We should pick a single canonical example and update the SDK snippets.

sanjay_infra: Runtime accepts both shapes for backwards compatibility. Prefer array in docs. Backend maps object -> array internally but we should discourage the object shape going forward. I'll confirm there are no edge cases.

katie_se: If we change examples, add a short migration note and show multipart/form-data example for file uploads vs base64 in JSON. We can't surprise customers.

maria_dev: Agreed. Proposed plan: update examples to use array, add migration note that single-object is accepted for legacy clients, update curl/python/node snippets, and link to sample SDK helper in the samples repo. Proposed JSON example:

```json
{
  "prompt": "Summarize the attached notes",
  "attachments": [
    {"filename":"notes.txt","content":"SGVsbG8=","content_type":"text/plain"}
  ]
}
```

tim_docs: @sanjay_infra can you confirm server still accepts base64 in "content" and multipart uploads (files param)? If yes we'll include both snippets.

sanjay_infra: Confirmed: server accepts base64 JSON content and multipart/form-data with "attachments[]". Gateway maps both reliably. No behavior change expected. I filed infra ticket #998 to add explicit tests.

katie_se: I'll draft the migration blurb. Support also asked to see a python requests example using files= for multipart. I'll prepare that and attach to the PR.

tim_docs: I'll update the docs PR with array examples and add python/curl/node multipart + base64 JSON snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 (WIP). Will mark ready once snippets are in.

maria_dev: :thumbsup: once PR is ready, can we get a quick pass from support on phrasing? @katie_se please ping them.

docs-bot: Deployment preview available: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.com (preview expires in 48h)

katie_se: Pinged support. They suggested this wording for migration note: "If your integration sends attachments as a single object, no action is required; the API will continue to accept the legacy shape. We recommend migrating to an array of attachments for consistency and future-proofing." I'll paste in the PR.

tim_docs: Updated PR with array examples + migration note + multipart samples. Ready for final review, assigning to @maria_dev.

maria_dev: LGTM, merging in 10m unless objections. Thanks everyone!
